verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's registered-agent docs say official mail and documents are scanned and uploaded to the customer's secure cloud storage account. They also cover email alerts and reminders when mail arrives, digital access from anywhere, and a dashboard that acts as a hub for documents, so the core of the story is delivered. Sharing is documented only for business licenses, not for scanned state mail. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of downloading and sharing scanned mail, independent or hands-on corroboration of the mail-scanning workflow.
